posts.zh:
dsh-web-lan-access 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Web UI 局域网/远程访问：为纯 HTTP 非安全上下文注入 crypto.randomUUID polyfill，局域网/Tailscale IP 直连时前端不再崩溃。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b14e8ca9bc39cd9d8195.html
posts.en:
dsh-web-lan-access is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. LAN/remote access for the Web UI: injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill on plain-HTTP origins so the frontend survives LAN or Tailscale IP direct links.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b14e8ca9bc39cd9d8195.html
